extDescription.message: Mark production and test sites with ribbons, banners and outlines so you never mix them up. Private: data stays on your device.

commandStartPicker.message: Pick an element to mark on this page

commandToggleHide.message: Show or hide the marks on this tab
commandToggleHide.description: Keyboard shortcut description in the browser's shortcut settings (toggle-hide command).

scaffoldNotice.message: Under construction. See docs/tasks.md for progress.

markerCollapseBanner.description: Accessible name of the chevron button on a SiteMark banner shown on a web page. Collapses the banner to a small tab.

markerExpandBanner.description: Accessible name of the small tab a collapsed SiteMark banner leaves on a web page. Shows the full banner again.

siteGroupCount_one.description: Number of site groups, e.g. in the settings sidebar.

siteGroupCount_other.description: Number of site groups, e.g. in the settings sidebar.

errorPatternEmpty.description: URL pattern error: the pattern is empty.

errorPatternTooLong.message: A pattern can be at most 500 characters long.
errorPatternTooLong.description: URL pattern error: the pattern is too long.

errorPatternTooManyWildcards.message: A pattern can contain at most 10 wildcards (*).
errorPatternTooManyWildcards.description: URL pattern error: too many * characters.

errorPatternInvalidScheme.message: Use http, https or * as the scheme.
errorPatternInvalidScheme.description: URL pattern error: the part before :// is not allowed.

errorPatternWildcardInHost.message: A wildcard is only allowed at the start of the host.
errorPatternWildcardInHost.description: URL pattern error: a * appears in the middle of the host name.

errorPatternInvalidHost.message: Enter a valid host name, such as example.com.
errorPatternInvalidHost.description: URL pattern error: the host name is not valid.

errorPatternInvalidPort.message: Enter a valid port number, such as 8080.
errorPatternInvalidPort.description: URL pattern error: the port is not a valid number.

errorPatternInvalidIpv6.message: Enter a valid IPv6 address in brackets, such as [::1].
errorPatternInvalidIpv6.description: URL pattern error: the IPv6 address is not valid.

errorPatternTooBroad.message: This pattern matches too many sites. Use a specific domain, such as *.example.com.
errorPatternTooBroad.description: URL pattern error: the pattern covers all sites or a whole public suffix such as *.co.uk.

errorUrlTooLong.message: This URL is too long to check (more than 2048 characters).
errorUrlTooLong.description: Shown when a URL to test is longer than 2048 characters.

errorRegexInvalid.message: This regular expression is not valid.
errorRegexInvalid.description: Regex pattern error: the expression does not parse.

errorRegexUnsafe.message: Not allowed: backreferences, lookarounds, nested quantifiers, (a|b) inside a repeat, or repeats that can match the same text (start with ^ or use a narrower class like [^/]+).
errorRegexUnsafe.description: Regex pattern error: the expression uses a feature that could make matching slow.

errorRegexTooLong.message: A regular expression can be at most 500 characters long.
errorRegexTooLong.description: Regex pattern error: the expression is too long.

errorRegexNeedsOrigin.message: Add at least one origin, such as *://example.com/*, for this regular expression.
errorRegexNeedsOrigin.description: Regex pattern error: a regex needs the sites (origins) it may run on.

errorRegexTooManyOrigins.message: A regular expression can have at most 20 origins.
errorRegexTooManyOrigins.description: Regex pattern error: too many origins.

errorImportInvalidJson.message: This file is not valid JSON.
errorImportInvalidJson.description: Import error: the file cannot be read as JSON.

errorImportTooDeep.message: This file is nested too deeply to be a SiteMark export.
errorImportTooDeep.description: Import error: the JSON is nested too deeply.

errorImportTooLarge.message: This file is too large to import.
errorImportTooLarge.description: Import error: the file exceeds the size limit.

errorImportSchemaInvalid.message: This file is not a valid SiteMark export.
errorImportSchemaInvalid.description: Import error: the JSON does not have the SiteMark export format.

errorImportPatternInvalid.message: This file contains a URL pattern SiteMark does not accept, for example one that matches too many sites.
errorImportPatternInvalid.description: Import error: a URL pattern or exclude in the file is invalid, unsafe or too broad. The UI lists each pattern with its own error.

errorImportUnsupportedVersion.message: This file comes from a newer or unknown version of SiteMark. Update SiteMark and try again.
errorImportUnsupportedVersion.description: Import error: the export has a schema version this build cannot read.

errorStateReadOnly.message: Your data comes from a newer version of SiteMark, so changes are turned off to keep it safe.
errorStateReadOnly.description: Shown when a change is refused because the stored data is read-only.

errorStateUnreadable.message: Your saved SiteMark data could not be read, so SiteMark started with the defaults. A backup of the old data was kept.
errorStateUnreadable.description: Shown on the options page when the stored data is damaged and was replaced by the defaults.

errorStorageFailed.message: SiteMark could not save your change. Your browser's storage may be full.
errorStorageFailed.description: Shown when a change is not saved because the browser refused to write the data, for example because storage is full.

errorSiteGroupNeedsPattern.message: Add a URL pattern before you turn on this site group.
errorSiteGroupNeedsPattern.description: Site group error: an enabled site group needs at least one URL pattern.

errorSiteGroupNameInvalid.message: Enter a name of 1 to 40 characters.
errorSiteGroupNameInvalid.description: Site group error: the site group name is empty or longer than 40 characters.

errorSiteGroupLimitReached.message: You can have at most 200 site groups.
errorSiteGroupLimitReached.description: Site group error: the maximum number of site groups is reached.

errorPatternLimitReached.message: A site group can have at most 50 URL patterns.
errorPatternLimitReached.description: Site group error: the maximum number of URL patterns is reached.

errorExcludeLimitReached.message: A site group can have at most 50 exclude patterns.
errorExcludeLimitReached.description: Site group error: the maximum number of exclude patterns is reached.

errorMarkLimitReached.message: A site group can have at most 50 marks.
errorMarkLimitReached.description: Site group error: the maximum number of marks is reached.

errorSiteGroupNotFound.message: This site group no longer exists.
errorSiteGroupNotFound.description: Site group error: the site group was deleted, for example in another window.

errorPatternNotFound.description: Site group error: the URL or exclude pattern was removed, for example in another window.

errorMarkNotFound.description: Site group error: the mark was removed, for example in another window.

errorMarkInvalid.message: This mark has settings that SiteMark can't save. Check its effects, colors and selector.
errorMarkInvalid.description: Site group error: a mark failed validation (for example no effect, an empty selector or an invalid color).

errorCommandProducedInvalidState.message: Something went wrong, so your change was not saved. Please try again.
errorCommandProducedInvalidState.description: Command error: applying the change would have produced invalid data (a SiteMark bug), so nothing was saved.

grantTitle.description: Heading of the grant page, which asks for access to the listed sites.

grantExplanation.message: SiteMark needs access to these sites to show your marks on every visit.
grantExplanation.description: Grant page: why SiteMark asks for access.

grantSites.description: Grant page: accessible name of the list of sites SiteMark asks access to.

grantAllow.description: Grant page button that opens the browser's permission prompt.

grantGranted.message: Access granted. You can close this tab.
grantGranted.description: Grant page: shown after the user allowed access.

grantDenied.message: Access was not granted. Your marks won't show on these sites until you allow it.
grantDenied.description: Grant page: shown after the user declined the browser's permission prompt.

grantFailed.message: SiteMark couldn't ask for access. Please try again.
grantFailed.description: Grant page: shown when the browser could not show its permission prompt.

grantInvalid.message: This link doesn't name a valid site. Open it again from SiteMark.
grantInvalid.description: Grant page: shown when the page was opened with a broken or tampered link.

popupSiteGroups.description: Popup: accessible name of the list of site groups whose URL patterns match the current tab.

popupGroupDisabled.description: Popup: status of a matching site group that is turned off. Ends with a dash and is followed by a link "enable in settings".

popupEnableInSettings.description: Popup: link after "Disabled —" that opens the site group in the settings page. Starts lowercase.

popupNoMatch.message: No site group matches this site
popupNoMatch.description: Popup: shown when no site group's URL patterns match the current tab.

popupMarkThisSite.description: Popup button that creates a site group for the current site with a blue ribbon.

popupMarkThisSiteHint.message: Your browser will ask to let SiteMark show marks on this site.
popupMarkThisSiteHint.description: Popup: microcopy under the Mark this site button, announcing the browser's permission prompt.

popupNotResponding.message: SiteMark didn't respond. Close this popup and try again.
popupNotResponding.description: Popup: shown when the extension's background did not answer a request, for example while SiteMark updates.

popupNeedsAccess.message: SiteMark needs access to $HOST$ to show your marks on every visit.
popupNeedsAccess.description: Popup: warning when a matching site group's site isn't granted yet. Followed by an Allow button.

popupAllow.description: Popup button that opens the browser's permission prompt for the current site.

popupElementMarks.description: Popup: accessible name of the list of element marks under a site group.

popupMarkFound.description: Popup: status of an element mark whose element was found on the page. Lowercase.

popupMarkNotFound.description: Popup: status of an element mark whose element is not on the page. Lowercase.

popupRepick.description: Popup button next to an element mark that wasn't found: pick its element again.

popupRepickLabel.description: Popup: accessible name of the Re-pick button, naming the element mark it re-picks.

popupFaviconUnavailable.message: Favicon tint unavailable on this page
popupFaviconUnavailable.description: Popup: the page's favicon couldn't be read, so the favicon tint of a mark isn't shown.

popupPickElement.description: Popup button that starts the element picker on the current page.

popupHide.description: Popup toggle button that hides all SiteMark marks on the current tab until reload.

popupPickShortcut.description: Popup: the keyboard shortcut of the element picker, as the browser reports it.

popupShortcut.description: Popup: the keyboard shortcut the user assigned to Hide on this tab.

popupSettings.description: Popup link that opens SiteMark's settings page in a new tab.

popupCantRun.message: SiteMark can't run on this page
popupCantRun.description: Popup: shown on pages where the browser doesn't let extensions run (browser pages, files, PDFs, extension stores).

popupCantRunReason.message: Browsers keep extensions off their own pages, local files, PDFs and extension stores.
popupCantRunReason.description: Popup: explanation under "SiteMark can't run on this page".

popupOpenSettings.description: Popup link under a data problem (read-only or unreadable data) that opens the Data page of SiteMark's settings.

pickerFrameNote.description: Picker tooltip note when the pointer is over an iframe: the whole frame gets the mark.

pickerComponentNote.description: Picker tooltip note when the pointer is over a web component: the component gets the mark.

pickerPaneName.description: Accessible name of the in-page element picker while it has the keyboard focus.

pickerHint.message: Click to select · ↑↓←→ navigate · Enter select · Esc cancel
pickerHint.description: Hint bar at the top of the page while picking an element.

pickerSize.description: Screen reader announcement of the size of the element under the picker, in pixels.

pickerPanelTitle.description: Picker panel: title of the mini panel shown after an element was selected.

pickerSelectorLabel.description: Picker panel: label of the editable CSS selector field.

pickerMatchOne.description: Picker panel: the selector finds exactly the picked element. Shown after a check mark.

pickerMatchNone.description: Picker panel: the selector finds nothing on the page. Shown after a cross.

pickerMatchInvalid.description: Picker panel: the typed text is not a valid CSS selector. Shown after a cross.

pickerSiteGroupLabel.description: Picker panel: label of the site group choice.

pickerEffectsLabel.description: Picker panel: label of the effect chips.

pickerEffectRibbon.description: Picker panel: effect chip for a corner ribbon on the element.

pickerEffectOutline.description: Picker panel: effect chip for an outline around the element.

pickerEffectTint.description: Picker panel: effect chip for a color overlay on the element.

pickerEffectStripes.description: Picker panel: effect chip for diagonal stripes over the element.

pickerColorLabel.description: Picker panel: label of the color presets.

pickerColorRed.description: Picker panel: accessible name of the red color preset.

pickerColorAmber.description: Picker panel: accessible name of the amber color preset.

pickerColorBlue.description: Picker panel: accessible name of the blue color preset.

pickerColorSlate.description: Picker panel: accessible name of the slate (grey) color preset.

pickerSave.description: Picker panel: button that saves the mark.

pickerCancel.description: Picker panel: button that ends the pick without saving.

pickerMoreOptions.description: Picker panel: button that saves the mark and opens it in the options page.

pickerMatchMany.description: Picker panel: the selector finds several elements; only the first gets the mark.

pickerNewSiteGroup.description: Picker panel: site group choice that creates a new group for this site.

pickerMovePanel.description: Picker panel: button that moves the panel to the next corner of the page (no dragging needed).

pickerNotGranted.message: Shown on this tab only. Allow SiteMark on this site to keep it.
pickerNotGranted.description: Picker panel, after saving on a site SiteMark has no access to yet: the mark shows until the tab is reloaded.

pickerAllow.description: Picker panel button that opens SiteMark's page to grant access to this site.

pickerClose.description: Picker panel button that closes the panel after saving.

pickerRepickTitle.description: Picker panel title when re-picking the element of an existing mark whose element was not found.

optionsLoading.description: Options page: shown until the settings are loaded.

optionsUnavailable.message: SiteMark can't show its settings right now. Reload this page to try again.
optionsUnavailable.description: Options page: shown when the settings could not be loaded.

optionsPages.description: Options page: accessible name of the navigation between its pages.

optionsSiteGroups.description: Options page: the site group list heading and navigation link.

optionsSettings.description: Options page: the Settings page heading and navigation link.

optionsData.description: Options page: the Data (export, import, reset) page heading and navigation link.

optionsNoGroups.message: No site groups yet. Add one to start marking sites.
optionsNoGroups.description: Options page: shown in the editor pane when there are no site groups.

welcomeIntro.message: SiteMark marks the sites you choose, so you always know where you are.

welcomeSteps.description: Welcome tab: heading of the three getting-started steps.

welcomeStepOpen.message: Open a site you want to mark.

welcomeStepMark.message: Click the SiteMark icon and choose Mark this site.
welcomeStepMark.description: Welcome tab: step 2. 'Mark this site' is the popup button's label.

welcomeStepAllow.message: Allow SiteMark on that site when your browser asks.

welcomePin.message: Pin SiteMark: open the puzzle-piece menu in the toolbar and click the pin next to SiteMark.
welcomePin.description: Welcome tab: how to pin the extension to the toolbar.

welcomeShortcut.message: Press $SHORTCUT$ on any page to pick an element to mark.
welcomeShortcut.description: Welcome tab: the keyboard shortcut of the element picker.

welcomeShortcutUnset.message: Picking an element has no keyboard shortcut yet. You can set one in your browser's shortcut settings.
welcomeShortcutUnset.description: Welcome tab: shown when the element picker has no keyboard shortcut.

errorSiteGroupExists.message: This site group is already in the list.
errorSiteGroupExists.description: Error: undoing a delete for a site group that is already back.

optionsNewGroup.description: Options page: label of the name field for a new site group.

optionsAddGroup.description: Options page: button that adds a site group at the bottom of the list.

optionsGroupName.description: Site group editor: label of the name field.

optionsDeleteGroup.description: Site group editor: button that deletes the site group (after confirmation).

optionsDeleteGroupTitle.description: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting a site group.

optionsDeleteGroupBody.message: Its URL patterns and marks are deleted too.
optionsDeleteGroupBody.description: Body of the dialog that confirms deleting a site group.

optionsCancel.description: Options page: button that closes a dialog without doing anything.

optionsDelete.description: Options page: button that confirms a delete.

optionsGroupDeleted.description: Toast after a site group was deleted; it offers Undo for 10 seconds.

optionsUndo.description: Toast action that undoes the last delete.

optionsDismiss.description: Accessible name of the button that closes a toast.

optionsSendFailed.message: SiteMark couldn't save this change. Please try again.
optionsSendFailed.description: Options page: shown when the background did not answer a change.

optionsEnabled.description: Site group editor: label of the switch that turns the site group on or off.

optionsGroupOn.description: Site group list: the site group is turned on.

optionsGroupOff.description: Site group list: the site group is turned off.

optionsMoveUp.description: Site group list: accessible name of the button that raises a site group's priority by one place.

optionsMoveDown.description: Site group list: accessible name of the button that lowers a site group's priority by one place.

optionsDuplicateGroup.description: Site group editor: button that adds a copy of the site group (turned off) at the bottom of the list.

optionsPatterns.description: Site group editor: heading of the list of URL patterns.

optionsPatternType.description: Site group editor: label of the choice between a wildcard pattern and a regular expression.

optionsPatternWildcard.description: Pattern type: a wildcard pattern such as *.example.com.

optionsPatternInput.description: Site group editor: label of the field for a new pattern.

optionsPatternHelp.description: Help text below the wildcard pattern field.

optionsRegexHelp.message: A regular expression, tested against the full URL.
optionsRegexHelp.description: Help text below the pattern field when the type is Regex.

optionsOrigins.description: Site group editor: label of the field for the sites a regular expression runs on.

optionsOriginsHelp.message: The sites this regular expression runs on, separated by commas, such as https://example.com
optionsOriginsHelp.description: Help text below the Origins field.

optionsAddPattern.description: Site group editor: button that adds the typed pattern (and asks for access to its sites).

optionsRemovePattern.description: Accessible name of the button that removes a URL pattern.

optionsRegexOn.description: Pattern list: the origins a regular expression runs on.

optionsAutoDisabled.message: “$NAME$” was turned off because it has no URL patterns left.
optionsAutoDisabled.description: Toast after removing a site group's last URL pattern turned the group off.
